findings.highlight: There's a more practical appeal to being formulaic.
findings.evidenceJa: 数式はもっと機能的で美しいんだぞ
findings.explanation: Haruki pedantically answers the charge that his lyrics resemble equations by saying equations are much more functional and beautiful. Todokanai TL turns 数式 into the adjective 'formulaic' and deletes both halves of the joke.
findings.japanese:
「馬鹿言うな。
…数式はもっと機能的で美しいんだぞ」
findings.todokanai: "Don't be silly. …There's a more practical appeal to being formulaic."

findings.highlight: Why did I have to be assigned photography work today of all days!?
findings.evidenceJa: どうして今日に限って撮影が押すかなぁっ！
findings.explanation: Tomo complains that the shoot ran late today, not that she was assigned photography work that day.
findings.japanese: 「どうして今日に限って撮影が押すかなぁっ！」
findings.todokanai: "Why did I have to be assigned photography work today of all days!?"

findings.highlight: It's getting hard to breathe…
findings.evidenceJa: なんか息もつかせぬって感じなんだもん
findings.explanation: 息もつかせぬ describes the concert's breathtaking, unrelenting intensity. Todokanai TL literalizes it as Io suffering respiratory difficulty.
findings.japanese:
「どうしよ…鳥肌立ってる。
なんか息もつかせぬって感じなんだもん」
findings.todokanai: "What's wrong with me…? I'm getting goosebumps all over. It's getting hard to breathe…"

findings.highlight: the pain and numbness in them have finally subsided.
findings.evidenceJa: 指先の痛みと痺れが、そろそろ気持ちいい段階にまで突入してる
findings.explanation: Haruki says the pain and numbness have crossed into the perversely pleasant stage; they have not subsided.
findings.japanese:
しかも、指先の痛みと痺れが、
そろそろ気持ちいい段階にまで突入してるけど。
findings.todokanai: Plus, my fingers are just about starting to feel good again, given that the pain and numbness in them have finally subsided.

findings.highlight: I've made myself clear.
findings.evidenceJa: 言ってろ。
findings.explanation: 言ってろ dismisses Youko's boast as 'say what you like' or 'keep talking.' Todokanai TL reverses the speaking party and makes Kazusa claim she has made herself clear.
findings.japanese:
「言ってろ。
本当なら共演して叩き潰してやりたいところだけど、
あんたの名誉と健康のために自重しとく」
findings.todokanai: "I've made myself clear. I could've crushed you if we ended up performing together, but I decided against it in consideration of both your reputation and your health."

findings.highlight: to wow guests of a higher caliber, to be endorsed by fellow performers of a higher level
findings.evidenceJa: レベルの高い観客に揉まれて、レベルの高い共演者に恵まれて
findings.explanation: Youko asks whether Kazusa wants to be tested and tempered by discerning audiences and blessed with high-level collaborators. The translation changes those developmental pressures into impressing guests and receiving endorsements.
findings.japanese:
「レベルの高い観客に揉まれて、
レベルの高い共演者に恵まれて、
ずっと世界で戦っていたい？」
findings.todokanai: "You wish to wow guests of a higher caliber, to be endorsed by fellow performers of a higher level, and to fight against the world forever?"

findings.highlight: It's actually quite flashy…
findings.evidenceJa: 実は結構重いんだけどさ
findings.explanation: Kazusa says the concert dress is quite heavy, not flashy.
findings.japanese:
「どうだこれ？
実は結構重いんだけどさ」
findings.todokanai: "What do you think? It's actually quite flashy…"

findings.highlight: I can't really hear you.
findings.evidenceJa: 聞くな聞くな。
findings.explanation: Kazusa says 'Don't ask, don't ask'; she is not claiming she cannot hear Haruki.
findings.japanese:
「あ～、聞くな聞くな。
そのことに関しては、今は何も話したくない」
findings.todokanai: "Huh? I can't really hear you. I really don't wanna talk about anything related to that right now."

findings.highlight: A guitarist who was lambasted for his lack of skill over and over again. A pianist who was forced to play along time after time despite doing nothing wrong. A singer who kept comfortably singing, without thinking of anything else.
findings.evidenceJa:
ダメ出しを食らいまくってたギター。
何も悪くないのに何度も付き合わされていたピアノ。
諸事情関係なしに気持ちよく歌い続けてたボーカル。
findings.explanation: 諸事情関係なしに says Setsuna kept singing happily regardless of every circumstance; 'without thinking of anything else' makes her oblivious rather than irrepressible — The three contrasting rehearsal roles remain recognizable.
findings.japanese:
ダメ出しを食らいまくってたギター。
何も悪くないのに何度も付き合わされていたピアノ。
諸事情関係なしに気持ちよく歌い続けてたボーカル。
findings.todokanai: A guitarist who was lambasted for his lack of skill over and over again. A pianist who was forced to play along time after time despite doing nothing wrong. A singer who kept comfortably singing, without thinking of anything else.

findings.highlight: the slightest feeling of loneliness.
findings.evidenceJa: 少なからぬ寂寥感。
findings.explanation: 少なからぬ means a not inconsiderable measure of loneliness. 'The slightest' minimizes exactly what the Japanese emphasizes.
findings.japanese: そして、少なからぬ寂寥感。
findings.todokanai: As well as the slightest feeling of loneliness.

findings.highlight: I owe everything that I've been capable of doing up until now to you
findings.evidenceJa: あたしが今ここにいられるのは、全部、雪菜のおかげだ
findings.explanation: Kazusa says her being here now is entirely thanks to Setsuna. Todokanai TL expands this into owing every accomplishment up to the present to her.
findings.japanese:
「あたしが今ここにいられるのは、
全部、雪菜のおかげだ」
findings.todokanai: "I owe everything that I've been capable of doing up until now to you, Setsuna."

findings.highlight: will never be able to love her again.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分を愛さなかった俺を。
findings.explanation: Haruki calls himself the man who did not love Kazusa. The translation changes his past moral failure into a future inability to love her.
findings.japanese:
自分を見捨てた俺を。
自分を愛さなかった俺を。
findings.todokanai: She intends to separate from meーthe person who's abandoned her and will never be able to love her again.

findings.highlight: You don't need to give me a place I can aim for. I only ask that you give me a place I can return to.
findings.evidenceJa: あたしの目指す場所じゃなくていい。ただ、あたしの帰る場所でいてくれればいい
findings.explanation: Kazusa tells Youko she need not remain the destination Kazusa strives toward; she need only be the place Kazusa returns to. Todokanai TL makes Youko the giver of both places, weakening the mother-as-home contrast.
findings.japanese:
「あたしの目指す場所じゃなくていい。
ただ、あたしの帰る場所でいてくれればいい」
findings.todokanai: "You don't need to give me a place I can aim for. I only ask that you give me a place I can return to."

findings.highlight: Nor does Kazusa herself cause a stir.
findings.evidenceJa: そしてかずさだって、それどころの騒ぎじゃなかった。
findings.explanation: Kazusa is in no position to cry or react sentimentally because Setsuna's breakdown is now the emergency. The translation instead states, incoherently, that Kazusa does not cause a stir.
findings.japanese: そしてかずさだって、それどころの騒ぎじゃなかった。
findings.todokanai: Nor does Kazusa herself cause a stir.

findings.highlight: Don't take me for another girl.
findings.evidenceJa: あたし相手に、作んな
findings.explanation: Io tells Takeya not to put on an act with her. The translation turns 作る into treating her as another woman and obscures the setup for Takeya admitting that he is performing.
findings.japanese: 「あたし相手に、作んな」
findings.todokanai: "Don't take me for another girl."

findings.highlight: It's natural that I'd make my move, no? After all, you're so meek the way you are now.
findings.evidenceJa: 作るに決まってるだろ。だって素だといけそうじゃん、今のお前
findings.explanation: Takeya says of course he is putting on an act: if he were his unvarnished self, the present Io seems attainable. Todokanai TL changes acting into making a sexual move and invents that Io is meek.
findings.japanese:
「作るに決まってるだろ。
だって素だといけそうじゃん、今のお前」
findings.todokanai: "It's natural that I'd make my move, no? After all, you're so meek the way you are now."

findings.highlight: I wouldn't want to discover that I've been under nothing but a delusion after that.
findings.evidenceJa: 後で気の迷いだったとか思われそうな状況はヤなの
findings.explanation: Takeya rejects a situation in which Io might later decide her consent was only a momentary lapse. Todokanai TL makes Takeya the person who might discover he was deluded.
findings.japanese:
「とにかく俺はね、
そういう、後で気の迷いだったとか思われそうな
状況はヤなの」
findings.todokanai: "In any case, I wouldn't want to discover that I've been under nothing but a delusion after that."

findings.highlight: I wonder if it'll be acceptable.
findings.evidenceJa: うまく行ったな
findings.explanation: Haruki states with satisfaction that it went well. The translation converts this into doubt about whether it will be accepted.
findings.japanese: 「うまく行ったな」
findings.todokanai: "I wonder if it'll be acceptable."

findings.highlight: Kazusa's not going to forgive me anymore.
findings.evidenceJa: かずさはもう、許しはしなかった。
findings.explanation: In context 許す means Kazusa will no longer permit Haruki to remain with her or keep circling indecisively; she orders him to go to Setsuna. It is not a declaration that she will not forgive him.
findings.japanese: かずさはもう、許しはしなかった。
findings.todokanai: Kazusa's not going to forgive me anymore.

findings.highlight: the person I once loved.
findings.evidenceJa: さようなら…あたしの愛した春希
findings.explanation: Kazusa's 愛した is an attributive farewell to the Haruki she has loved, not a claim that her love is over. She explicitly says immediately before and after this that she will love him forever. 'Once loved' introduces a contradiction absent from the Japanese.
findings.japanese: 「さようなら…あたしの愛した春希」
findings.todokanai: "Goodbye, Haruki… the person I once loved."

findings.highlight: ease and resentment
findings.evidenceJa: 安堵と悔恨の色
findings.explanation: 悔恨 is regret or remorse, not resentment. Setsuna is simultaneously relieved at being chosen and remorseful about what that choice does to Kazusa.
findings.japanese:
そして、そんな数々の表情の中に、
安堵と悔恨の色が同時にさぁっと広がっていく。
findings.todokanai: And within her varying expressions, I can see ease and resentment spreading across her face simultaneously.

findings.highlight: I love Kazusa. And I love you more than anything, Setsuna.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺、かずさのことが好きだ。そして俺、雪菜を愛してる
findings.explanation: The load-bearing distinction is 好き for Kazusa versus 愛してる for Setsuna: 'I love Kazusa. But I'm in love with you, Setsuna.' Todokanai TL replaces that contrast with an unsupported comparative 'more than anything,' flattening the precise emotional taxonomy.
findings.japanese:
「俺、かずさのことが好きだ。
そして俺、雪菜を愛してる」
findings.todokanai: "I love Kazusa. And I love you more than anything, Setsuna."

findings.highlight: in my ignorance of her lingering affections for me.
findings.evidenceJa: かずさへの未練を、なにも知らずに振り切ろうとする俺じゃなく
findings.explanation: かずさへの未練 is Haruki's lingering attachment to Kazusa, not Kazusa's affection for him. He is rejecting the version of himself that unknowingly tried to shake off his own unresolved feelings.
findings.japanese:
かずさへの未練を、
なにも知らずに振り切ろうとする俺じゃなく。
findings.todokanai: Nor am I the person who brushed Kazusa away in my ignorance of her lingering affections for me.

findings.highlight: Did she say that? Did Kazusa really say something like that!?
findings.evidenceJa: 言ったの？かずさにそんなこと言っちゃったの！？
findings.explanation: Setsuna asks whether Haruki said those cruel terms to Kazusa. Todokanai TL reverses the direction and asks whether Kazusa said them.
findings.japanese:
「言ったの？
かずさにそんなこと言っちゃったの！？」
findings.todokanai: "Did she say that? Did Kazusa really say something like that!?"

findings.highlight: She did!
findings.evidenceJa: 言ったよ！
findings.explanation: Haruki answers 'I did!' Todokanai TL makes Kazusa the speaker again, extending the reversal from the preceding line.
findings.japanese:
「言ったよ！
だって俺が愛してるの雪菜だけだもん！」
findings.todokanai: "She did! Because you're the only one I truly love, Setsuna!"

findings.highlight: I sought you to help Kazusa after tossing her aside
findings.evidenceJa: かずさにふらついて、かずさとの解決を丸投げして
findings.explanation: Haruki confesses that he wavered toward Kazusa and dumped the work of resolving the Kazusa conflict onto Setsuna. Todokanai TL instead says he tossed Kazusa aside and then asked Setsuna to help her.
findings.japanese:
「だって俺、雪菜に酷いことばかりした。
かずさにふらついて、かずさとの解決を丸投げして、
それどころか、そのことずっと隠してて…」
findings.todokanai: "After all, I've been nothing but cruel to you, Setsuna. I sought you to help Kazusa after tossing her aside, and more importantly, I've hid that from you the whole time…"

findings.highlight: please don't leave me alone…!
findings.evidenceJa: 俺を、見殺しにしないで
findings.explanation: Haruki coercively pleads 'don't leave me to die.' 'Don't leave me alone' suppresses the deliberately ugly emotional extremity that Setsuna immediately condemns.
findings.japanese:
「それでも考えて…
俺を、見殺しにしないで」
findings.todokanai: "Even so, please consider… please don't leave me alone…!"

findings.highlight: Kazusa and I would finally be able to talk properly when she recovers.
findings.evidenceJa: かずさの回復を待って、ゆっくり話をすればいいと思う
findings.explanation: Setsuna tells Haruki he can wait for Kazusa's recovery and take his time talking with her. Todokanai TL makes the future conversation one between Setsuna and Kazusa.
findings.japanese:
『別に、わたしは急いでないから、
かずさの回復を待って、ゆっくり話をすればいいと思う』
findings.todokanai: "I'm really not urging you to hurry up or anything; I was simply thinking that Kazusa and I would finally be able to talk properly when she recovers."

findings.highlight: I was certain you had some time off recently.
findings.evidenceJa: 最近、ちょっと間が開いてたよね
findings.explanation: Setsuna says the intervals between Haruki's emails have been growing lately. The translation invents that he had time off work.
findings.japanese:
『一昨日も、メールくれなかったよね。
最近、ちょっと間が開いてたよね』
findings.todokanai: "You didn't send me one the day before yesterday either. But I was certain you had some time off recently."

findings.highlight: love me with all your heart and soul
findings.evidenceJa: わたしのこと体ごと愛して欲しいんだよ
findings.explanation: 体ごと explicitly asks Haruki to love Setsuna bodily, in the same physical way as before. 'Heart and soul' reverses the corporeal request into spiritual devotion and sanitizes the sexual meaning.
findings.japanese:
『いつもみたいに、わたしのこと
体ごと愛して欲しいんだよ』
findings.todokanai: "I want you to love me with all your heart and soul, just as you always used to…"

findings.highlight: had ended up clashing so violently in a dream
findings.evidenceJa: 決して俺に見せることのない夢想の中に、こんなにも詰め込んでいた
findings.explanation: Setsuna had packed both bright reason and dark feeling into imagined messages she would never show Haruki. Their collision is introduced later; Todokanai TL prematurely invents a violent clash and loses the unsent-fantasy container.
findings.japanese:
明るい理性と暗い感情を、
決して俺に見せることのない夢想の中に、
こんなにも詰め込んでいた。
findings.todokanai: Her bright rationality and her dark feelings had ended up clashing so violently in a dream that was never meant to be revealed to me.

findings.highlight: as I spent each passing day with Kazusa, only burning deep within Setsuna's chest as I burned it into cinders.
findings.evidenceJa: かずさと一緒に過ごしてた数日間も消えることなく、雪菜の胸の奥をちりちりと焦がしてた
findings.explanation: The fire kept singeing Setsuna's heart throughout the days Setsuna spent with Kazusa. Todokanai TL makes Haruki the one spending those days with Kazusa and then bizarrely makes him burn Setsuna's heart into cinders.
findings.japanese:
その火は、かずさと一緒に過ごしてた数日間も
消えることなく、雪菜の胸の奥をちりちりと焦がしてた。
findings.todokanai: And the flames had not faded as I spent each passing day with Kazusa, only burning deep within Setsuna's chest as I burned it into cinders.

findings.highlight: filling you with memories that will bind you until the day I die.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が死ぬまで窮屈な思いさせるけど、ごめんな
findings.explanation: Haruki apologizes that his possessive promise will make Setsuna feel constrained for the rest of his life. Todokanai TL invents binding memories and loses the admission that life with him will be confining.
findings.japanese:
「今度こそ…二度と離さない。
俺が死ぬまで窮屈な思いさせるけど、ごめんな」
findings.todokanai: "This time… we'll never be separated again. I'm sorry that I'm going to be filling you with memories that will bind you until the day I die."

findings.highlight: Her foot has managed to take one step forward
findings.evidenceJa: 足が、一歩を踏み出しかけて、そして必死でその場に留まる
findings.explanation: Setsuna starts to take a step but desperately stops herself before completing it. The translation says she successfully takes the step and only then remains in place.
findings.japanese:
足が、一歩を踏み出しかけて、
そして必死でその場に留まる。
findings.todokanai: Her foot has managed to take one step forward, but she desperately tries to remain there afterward.

findings.highlight: I willingly let go of what was truly precious to me so I could seize what was delivered to my hands.
findings.evidenceJa: 手に届くものを掴んだら、本当に大切なものを手放してしまいそうだった
findings.explanation: Setsuna feared that if she grasped the happiness within reach, she might let go of what was truly precious. Todokanai TL says she deliberately let go of the precious thing in order to seize what was offered.
findings.japanese:
「手に届くものを掴んだら、
本当に大切なものを手放してしまいそうだった。
だから、だから…すごく我慢したんだよ！」
findings.todokanai: "I willingly let go of what was truly precious to me so I could seize what was delivered to my hands. That's why… that's why… I've had to endure so much!"

findings.highlight: as if you're enticing the audience for the next chapter in your story
findings.evidenceJa: 『小木曽雪菜先生の次回作にご期待ください』
findings.explanation: Haruki quotes the stock manga-cancellation tag 'Please look forward to Ms. Setsuna Ogiso's next work.' Todokanai TL replaces the recognizable publishing joke with a vague paraphrase about enticing an audience.
findings.japanese:
「なんだよ、その
『小木曽雪菜先生の次回作にご期待ください』は」
findings.todokanai: "Why are you talking as if you're enticing the audience for the next chapter in your story?"

findings.highlight: Perhaps she wants to mention that I've yet to give her a birthday present
findings.evidenceJa: そういえば誕生日プレゼントまだ渡せてなかったな、とか。
findings.explanation: This is Haruki's own stream of possibilities—he recalls that he still has not given Setsuna her birthday present. Todokanai TL turns it into something Setsuna wants to mention to him.
findings.japanese: そういえば誕生日プレゼントまだ渡せてなかったな、とか。
findings.todokanai: Perhaps she wants to mention that I've yet to give her a birthday present or something along those lines.

findings.highlight: "Do you think we should skip this topic for today?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「今日くらいはそんなこと言わないでって、思った？」
findings.explanation: Setsuna asks whether Haruki thought 'at least today, don't say that'; the English turns her prediction of his thought into a neutral joint proposal to skip the topic — His discomfort and her refusal remain clear.
findings.japanese: 「今日くらいはそんなこと言わないでって、思った？」
findings.todokanai: "Do you think we should skip this topic for today?"
